unit: U2 present-cutout (full build after approved test shot)

api.render_twoshot(t, keys=None): 720x540 RGB PIL; t = global film seconds; keys None/'master' | 'late' | 'baseline' | dict override; return_state=True also returns the puppet state
api.render_box_insert(t, state='open'): 720x540; state closed|lid33|lid66|open|receipt; t = seconds into the insert (slow push-in 2.5%/s-ish, drift, hand breath)
api.render_receipt_insert(t): 720x540; t = seconds into the insert 0..4.5; unfold drawings at 0.0/0.4/0.8/1.2 s (on twos), push to the date line 1.6-4.5 s
api.load_keys(variant): keys from dialogue-cues.json gesture_keys[variant] by cue_id (fallback plan §6)
api.slot_screen_insert(t): slot centre on screen in the insert, plus normalised x

module.speed: about 0.4-0.6 s per two-shot frame, ~0.8 s per insert frame (single core numpy/cv2)
editor_notes: Already toned (one fixed curve + the print's own grain); do NOT re-grade present shots, only add captions.
S3a insert: render_box_insert(t - 19.5, 'open') for frames 468-515 lands on the empty slot; S5 box-in-slot is in the two-shot; use 'receipt' insert only if a closer look is wanted.
S4 receipt insert: render_receipt_insert(t - 31.5) for 31.5-36.0 (cue CUE-4i 756-784 = unfold).
baseline: render_twoshot(t, 'baseline') holds the lid closed, head 0, no receipt; for S3a in baseline hold the two-shot.
Box in the two-shot is open from CUT-S3a (468) onward; it is closed (lid crack 10 % at 185-196) before the flashback.

handmade.what: silver box: geometry from box-spec.json; guilloché front/top computed as V-groove engine-turning (rose r*f+0.18 sin(14a+30r) and a wave band, 38 cycles/w) at 900 px/w texture, area-filtered at 2-3x supersampling (no moire); Lambert + specular from V0's key (camera-right flash) with streak to paper white; old-mirror lid: plate reflection, wavy glass remap, tarnish blooms, wiped smudge, desilvered edge; velvet insert with pressed ring hollow, lit lip and empty slit; partial-lid states keep the engraved outer lid; receipt-in-slot state; contact shadow on the skirt; grain = the print's own

pawn receipt: typeset MONT-DE-PIÉTÉ · Bureau auxiliaire n° 7 · Reconnaissance N° 48 213 · Engagé le 14 mars 1953 · une bague or, un brillant · 9 000 F · Déposant : A. R.; Courier-like labels (Liberation Mono), clerk's hand (Liberation Serif Italic) on dotted lines, double rule border, off-axis (-13°) double-framed ENGAGÉ stamp whose ink breaks up on the paper tooth, multi-scale paper tooth from noise, centre fold with crease shading and paper back; fall from the waistcoat welt pocket with gravity (v*v), tumble, one bounce (restitution ~0.25) and settle
FK rig + timing: pieces rotate about fixed pivots within limits; drawings on twos except the head drop (on ones, 8 frames); box set-down with acceleration, contact, squash-settle

tone.verdict: two-shots p5 39, p50 75-79, p99 252, chroma 4.0 (pass); box inserts p5 44-50, p50 79-95, p99 253 (pass, closed insert p5 50 slightly above 45 because the lit silver fills the frame); receipt insert p50 ~158 (paper fills the frame; acceptable for a paper insert, p99 253)

absences: No sharp, bare hand of the woman in V0 (her right hand on the skirt is out of focus); her gloved hand from the sister frame LoC 2017831565 was used instead (same sitting).
His right hand is hidden behind her in V0 and not visible in any free frame of this sitting at usable size; CUE-3h is played as his arm lifting off the sofa back.
No breast-pocket opening is visible on his jacket in V0; the visible waistcoat welt pocket is used as 'his pocket'.
No new sound foraged by this unit (U1 owns sound).
known_limits: Her head at +8 (turn away) shows a little of the repaired wall at the right of her curls; at -11 the repair behind her is clean.
The gloved hands are light and soft (a 1942 glove), read as hands at 720 but have little finger detail at two-shot scale.
The receipt in the slot is drawn as a pale folded card standing in the slit, legible as paper, not as text.
